method: Compared retained factual transcription to cached primary table image and extracted final primary text. No source observations or errors altered. No new fits or row-mask searches.

sources.source: Conrad et al. 1999 final Table6, p379
Angel et al. 2022 final Fig3 caption, p8
Angel et al. 2022 Supplement S1, pS3

findings: All five Conrad C11/C12 values and printed errors match final Table6; KS derived as(C11+2C12)/3, not independently measured as a separate quantity.

Angel Fig3 caption explicitly excludes the two highest-pressure Conrad points; S1 gives five available and three used, with assigned sigmaP0.1GPa. The retained pressures1.6,3.5,6.95GPa are consistent with that mask.

Conrad Table6 labels parenthetical uncertainties1standard deviation; covariance is absent. Original analysis assumes1%velocity precision in Christoffel inversion(p377), which is not a directly supplied KS error.
No modulus scale is fitted for Conrad in the existing six-parameter reconstructed fit. Whether the author preprocessed the original Cij-derived KS or assigned different KS errors remains unknown.
This diagnostic does not infer that Conrad was omitted or that the data are erroneous.
conrad_covariance_qualification: Selected effective pressure errors at the constrained published-Kprime fit are dominated by assigned0.1GPa pressure widths. The covariance-compatible KS width upper bound is unchanged; unknown Cij covariance alone can only lower this already small contribution at the same coefficient state.
